newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: INSIGHT - Australian 10-yr bond regains confidence.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Australian 10-yr bond regains confidence.

text.p: *Long-dated Australian bond futures extended the rebound from this week's one month lows in SYCOM with the 10-year contract now targetting resistance at 93.470.
*U.S. Treasuries closed sharply higher after a series of market-friendly data.
Long-dated Australian bond futures extended the rebound from this week's one month low in SYCOM with the 10-year contract now targetting resistance at 93.470.
The contract overcame resistance at 93.410 and ended the after hours session at 93.420, up from Thursday's 93.355 open outcry close and compared with this week's 93.135 low.

Speculation of a further easing in monetary policy in the wake of Thursday's benign wages data and a strengthening U.S. Treasury market has helped to firm up local debt technicals, although the market still has a lot of work to do to get back to the all time high of 93.696, which was set on August 1.

U.S. Treasuries closed sharply higher after a series of market-friendly data which confirmed inflation was well under control and pushed fears about a Fed tightening out to the Federal Open Market Committee Meeting in November.
The July CPI showed a modest 0.2 percent rise, industrial production also rose 0.2 percent for the same month, while capacity utilisation fell to 83.1 percent.
There is no local data due for release on Friday.
